dogecoin.text: The bulls tried to push Solana above the 20-day EMA ($198) on Dec. 31, but the bears held their ground. Dogecoin DOGE has been trading between the $0.34-$0.30 support for the past few days and the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement level of $1.27. https://t.co/AjsreJNZKx

Solana (SOL) surged above the 20-day EMA ($201) on Jan. 2. Dogecoin’s (DOGE) consolidation between $0.30-$0.35 resolved to the upside on January 3. Both moving averages are flattening out, pointing to a possible range-bound action. https://t.co/bcvIfWnm38
